newsitem.title: DENMARK: Denmark sees 98 fiscal tightening around 0.25 pct.
newsitem.headline: Denmark sees 98 fiscal tightening around 0.25 pct.

text.p: Danish Finance Minister Mogens Lykketoft said on Tuesday that he expected 1998 fiscal tightening of approximately 0.25 percent of Gross Domestic Product.
"We expect a slightly lower level of tightening than in 1997, a financial tightening effect of 0.25 percent and this is the figure we have used in our forecasts," Lykketoft said.
Earlier Lykketoft's finance ministry issued a new budget outlook saying that it expected 1997 fiscal tightening equal to 0.4 percent of GDP.
Economists have recently warned that a more solid tightening is needed to pre-empt economic heating in Denmark. --Ole Mikkelsen, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33969654
